versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the alibabacloud-sas-install-agent skill.
- Manages Alibaba Cloud Security Center (SAS) agent onboarding, installation, authorization, asset queries, and security risk detection via the `aliyun` CLI.
- Implements strict security guidelines for credential handling, parameter confirmation, and permission troubleshooting.
- No functional or code changes—removed the documentation file skill-card.md.

- Minimum CLI version updated to aliyun CLI ≥ 3.3.3; now requires updating via a provided script and plugin update step.
- Introduced mandatory enable/disable of AI-mode for all Agent Skill invocations using specific CLI commands before/after any workflow.
- All aliyn CLI commands must now use the explicit user agent: AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-sas-install-agent.
- Expanded CLI setup and exit protocol; AI-mode must be explicitly disabled at every exit point, covering all workflow outcomes.
- Documentation and references updated to reflect stricter environment checks and CLI operational flow requirements.

Initial beta release.

- Provides guidance and tooling for onboarding and managing Alibaba Cloud Security Center (SAS) agent.
- Supports agent installation, removal, upgrade, and troubleshooting via the aliyun CLI.
- Enables asset, server, and version queries; checks protection status and authorization quota.
- Facilitates vulnerability/baseline/virus scans and software inventory queries on servers.
- Requires explicit user confirmation for all write operations and parameter values.
- Enforces strict security best practices: never prints or requests sensitive credentials, and guides remediation on permission failures.
